units: <cite ref="Pesachim 112a:4">Pes. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>נְקַרְקֵשׁ נכתמא וכ׳</he> (not <he>מקרקש</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 9) let him knock the lid against the pitcher.
<cite ref="Ketubot 86a:3">Keth. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>מְקרְקֵשׁ ליה זוזו</he> he makes the coins clapper to him, i.e. offers him a few Zuz; <cite ref="Gittin 40b">Gitt. 40ᵇ</cite> top.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:9">Cant. R. to VII, 9</cite> <he>הוון נסבין … והוון מְקַרְקְשִׁין בהון</he> they (Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah) took their idols, broke them and made of them bells which they hanged on their dogs and asses, and they clappered with them (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 46:1">Is. XLVI, 1</cite>); a. e.
